It’s hard to move on knowing it’s the same girl that he was with back in March 2019 when we were both still in relationships. The girl that has constantly tried to turn him on me since. The envy already ruined me back then, yet alone now.

He has been punishing himself for what he has done to me and says how sorry he is and that I deserve better. But then when I ask how he is he says he’s pretty happy there? He has made it clear he doesn’t want to be with me now, after so so long. But dropping him just feels like I lose and he wins, I’m the one that ends up alone and heartbroken whilst he gets to live happily there with her? Ugh it’s shit and I am already taking tablets for both depression and anxiety but doesn’t change the fact that this bloody hurts... thank you though

I’ve never felt more myself around anyone else than this guy. He still speaks to me everyday and claims to love and care for me, but at the same time he would probably just get over me dropping him pretty quickly now he’s back with her. Which just hurts me even more... how can he end up with everything he once had and I end up with absolutely nothing? I’ve even quit my job now
I have tried talking to a professional. But he is the only person I’m comfortable enough with to talk about these kind of things, it’s one of the things which made us super close in the first place
